cases.symptom: Full refunds on orders priced with cents pay out the wrong amount. Order 3003 cost 129.99 and the customer was refunded 130.
Customers who ask for two orders back in one message sometimes get one refund or none, and the reply says a person will follow up.
Refunds are going out on orders that belong to someone else, usually when the person asking quotes an amount.
